notes.title: More Rocks, Fixes, and Events! Update v1.1.6
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – Rock Simulator 2

New Rock

    New Rock: Pixel, featuring three unique cosmetics.
    This rock can be purchased for 4800 ST and is upgradable to level 100.

Bug Fixes
